LanguageData.DMS_VaultConsole.label: security console
LanguageData.DMS_VaultConsole.description: The vault's access-control terminal. The sealed storage doors answer only to this console, and its credentials expired along with the unit that owned the place. Hack it to release the doors.
LanguageData.DMS_VaultConsole.comps.0.notHackedInspec: Hack to release the sealed storage doors.
LanguageData.DMS_VaultConsole.comps.0.hackedLetterTex: Someone has broken into the vault's access-control system. The sealed storage doors are open.
LanguageData.DMS_VaultGateConsole.label: gate console
LanguageData.DMS_VaultGateConsole.description: The control terminal for a sector gate. The gate's sealed doors answer only to this console, and its credentials expired along with the unit that owned the place. Hack it to open the gate.
LanguageData.DMS_VaultGateConsole.comps.0.notHackedIn: Hack to open the sector gate.
